searchText: I definitely cannot make it today Im out too, I'll be driving. I thought the plan was to move this week's meeting to next week, have two in a row, then go back to opposite ACDE Let's move this to next week please Yes, EthCC also gets in the way. Protocol Calendar and Agenda Issue updated to reflect July 17th for the next EOF Implementers meeting. I think the main point is: DUPN1 - DUPN16 will simply not get deployed at all. Compilers will optimize this out. This seems (for me) like a waste of bytecode space Don't forget gas golfing for size. As long as we charge for gas by the byte for creates or limit sub containers to 16 bits of size. Exactly, so also for deployment: for DUP/SWAP1-16 we save 200 gas for deployment bytes. I think this is a good argument to bump DUPN/SWAPN with 16 bytes <@508125616940515329> what do you think about this?
